# Playful Startup Theme

[GitHub Download Link](https://github.com/EvobyteDigitalBiology/st-styled/blob/main/src/st_yled/themes/playful_startup/config.toml)

![Playful Startup Theme Preview Placeholder](https://evo-byte.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/playful_startup.png)

Playful Startup provides vibrant colors and energetic contrast for product demos and growth-focused apps.

## Highlights

- Bright accents for interactive workflows
- Friendly visual language for onboarding and demos
- Includes light and dark variants
